title: MIRA
scope: Illumina explanatory MIRA enrichment schematic, retaining its depicted fragmentation, soluble protein binding, glutathione-bead isolation and combined DNA purification/PCR block. Text-supported MIRA-chip and MIRA-Seq readout interfaces are optional continuations from the enriched-DNA endpoint; they are not drawn in the image. Exact capture-tag/support equivalence between the generic drawing and the cited applications is not assumed.

states.label: Genomic DNA containing methylated and unmethylated CpG sequence
features: Left context inset is labeled 5mc CpG island. Pink C symbols with 5mC marks identify methylated sites; green C symbols lack those marks. The expanded chain is an explanatory representation, not a separate synthesis step.
The methylated-CpG island inset and enlarged base chain describe the target within genomic DNA; there is no separate material-transfer arrow between these two explanatory views.

Description, first paragraph
evidence.quote: (MIRA) uses the high affinity of a methylated-CpG-binding protein complex (MBD2B and MBD3L1) to enrich regions with methylated CpG dinucleotides.

features: Two separate chains depict a methylated fragment retaining two pink modification marks and an unmarked green fragment. No terminal chemical groups are specified.

evidence.locator: Discussion / Methylome comparison; b00037; /article/body[1]/sec[3]/sec[2]/p[1]
evidence.quote: The MIRA technique is based on the high affinity of a two-protein complex formed by methyl-CpG-binding proteins (MBD) 2b and 3L1, which bind to methylated DNA in a methylated CpG density-dependent manner [31]. A plain line after PCR does not by itself specify native methylation chemistry. The figure does not establish that this DNA already has a particular sequencing adapter architecture.

operations.label: MBD2B/MBD3L1 protein complex
operations.description: Incubate fragmented DNA with the affinity protein complex, producing methylated DNA/protein complexes and a depicted unbound fraction.
operations.mechanism: MBD2B/MBD3L1 affinity binding to methylated CpG DNA.
operations.information_effect: Selects genomic fragments according to methylated-CpG binding. The schematic unmarked fragment is an idealized nonbinding example, not proof of perfect specificity.

operations.label: DNA purification / PCR amplification
operations.description: Recover DNA from the bead-associated material and amplify the enriched fraction, yielding the final DNA product. The two-line label is kept as one schematic block.

operations.label: MIRA-chip: labeling, array hybridization and scanning (text-supported interface)
operations.description: For the array branch only, use the enriched genomic amplicons in a labeled-DNA hybridization/scanning readout and compare the result with matched input DNA. This broad interface is reported by the array paper, not depicted in the PNG.
operations.mechanism: The application reports ligation-mediated PCR of MIRA-enriched DNA, then amplicon labeling, Nimblegen tiling-array hybridization and scanning. No label chemistry or unshown PCR/linker sequence is specified here.
operations.information_effect: Hybridization associates genomic DNA fragments with complementary array probes. Signal relative to input reports enrichment over the array-covered regions, with the selectivity limitations of the affinity enrichment.

Their supplied methods name recombinant-protein capture or a kit without establishing those interfaces. The referenced implementation-specific protocol or kit-version documentation is needed for exact core-operation assignment; this does not block the depicted MIRA core or the reported readout branches.

Is the card's stated minimum of two methylated CpGs a validated capture criterion for each scoped implementation, and under what assay scope? Two pink marks in the drawing illustrate a fragment rather than proving a threshold, the footnote PMID is mismatched, and the inspected full text supports density dependence rather than this hard rule. The correctly identified cited binding/protocol evidence would be needed to adopt the number; the regional enrichment architecture is already supported.
